column1: A Low-Resource Speech-Driven NLP Pipeline for Sinhala Dyslexia Assistance
column4: RANLP 2025 (Recent Advances in Natural Language Processing)
column7:
Introduces the first real-time NLP pipeline for Sinhala-speaking adults with dyslexia, integrating Whisper (STT), 
SinBERT (error classification), mT5 + Mistral (correction), and gTTS (TTS). Achieves 66% STT accuracy and 70% correction accuracy
 on a synthetically generated 3000-sample Sinhala dataset.

column1: SiTSE: Sinhala Text Simplification Dataset and Evaluation
column2:
Surangika Ranathunga, Rumesh Sirithunga,
 Himashi Rathnayake, Lahiru De Silva, 
Thamindu Aluthwala, Saman Peramuna, Ravi Shekhar
column7:
Presents SiTSE, the first human-curated sentence-level text simplification dataset for Sinhala, Models the task as a zero-resource seq2seq problem using 
mT5 and mBART, and shows that Intermediate Task Transfer Learning (ITTL) with translation as an auxiliary task outperforms all baselines.
Also introduces two new human evaluation error categories: "near exact copy" and "missing major fact".
